newsitem.title: USA: Safety 1st sets new bank agreement.
newsitem.headline: Safety 1st sets new bank agreement.

text.p: Safety 1st Inc said Monday it had signed a new loan agreement with its commercial banks providing for a $46 million line of credit, structured as a $14.7 million term loan and a $31.3 million revolving line of credit.
This facility replaces a $50 million loan agreement and leaves the maturity unchanged at May 1997.

The new agreement allows flexibility to pursue new business opportunities by providing for an additional $3 million line of credit to fund business opportunities that may arise such as better-than-anticipated customer response to a new product, the company said.
